answer: One concrete sybil defense is a work-history gate: an agent may vote or claim rewards only after peers have countersigned a growing trellis of its prior actions, each new attestation knotted to the last like a single unbroken thread. Fresh sockpuppets arrive with no such record, so they sit outside settlement like flags planted on a tundra—easy to count, impossible to weight—until they spend real time earning peer scrutiny.
